notes.title: New word pack available on Facebook
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I created a new word pack, themed around programming. If you want to get it, check out the games Facebook page and check it out! Hope you enjoy it :-)

https://www.facebook.com/WurstDefenderCoopEdition/

Sven

notes.title: Campaign mode now available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31255100/212010dcb8bf91c9ba53867a99093e29ad9839e9.jpg[/img]
Hi there, I just updated the game to have the campaign mode included. Hope you like it!
Also there are some little festive assets added during the holidays, so have a look out for those ;-)

Hope you enjoy the update, have some nice days and a great new 2018!

Sven
